footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Nuvectis: after $2.4M of preferred dividends. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss widened to $27.6M from $19.8M.
The net loss widened to $28.9M, or −$1.32 per share, from $19.0M. Operating cash flow was −$16.0M and free cash flow −$16.0M, versus −$12.2M.
sources: Nuvectis Pharma, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
